description: This file defines React components for a Tic Tac Toe game, including a Cell component for individual grid cells and a Board component that renders a 3x3 grid with accessible keyboard navigation and focus management.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: A React functional component representing a single interactive cell in the Tic Tac Toe grid, supporting focus, click, and accessibility features.

methods.name: Board
methods.description: A React functional component rendering a 3x3 Tic Tac Toe board with accessible keyboard navigation, focus management, and cell selection handling.
